description: The deadline-evidence projection sync/lease/core/records.py write_session_evidence refreshes on every lease-record save, so orphan derivation keeps an evidenced deadline if the record itself is lost. A verbatim projection of the named fields — spec is the record's shape_spec.

venue.description: The venue the lease belongs to (S5 amendment, plan §7 V1): the projection carries the record's venue key, stamped with it from the first extracted write and by the §10.3 migration on the legacy stock.
